method: Source code trace + CUDA event timing
per_kernel_timing: BLOCKED — individual kernel separation requires modifying gsplat source to insert CUDA events around each backward kernel launch

backward_kernels.name: rasterize_to_pixels_3dgs_bwd
backward_kernels.purpose: Main backward kernel: scatter-add gradient accumulation for means2d, conics, colors, opacities
backward_kernels.critical_operation: gpuAtomicAdd — approximately 10 atomic float additions per valid Gaussian-pixel pair

backward_kernels.name: spherical_harmonics_bwd
backward_kernels.purpose: Gradients w.r.t. SH coefficients from render color gradients

backward_kernels.name: projection_ewa_3dgs_fused_bwd
backward_kernels.purpose: Backward through 3D→2D projection: v_means, v_quats, v_scales from v_means2d, v_conics, v_depths

backward_kernels.name: quat_scale_to_covar_preci_bwd
backward_kernels.purpose: Gradients w.r.t. quaternions and scales from covariance gradients

kernel_launch_sequence:
1. rasterize_to_pixels_3dgs_bwd (dominant, grid=tile_h×tile_w×I, block=tile_size²)
2. spherical_harmonics_bwd (SH grads, grid=nnz/256)
3. projection_ewa_3dgs_fused_bwd (projection grads, grid=N/256)
4. quat_scale_to_covar_preci_bwd (quat/scale grads, grid=N/256)
path_difference: None — same 4 kernels, same binary. Only grid/block dims differ for kernel 1.
nsight_blocker: WDDM — cannot use Nsight Compute on this GPU/driver configuration
